description: Firewall template get fetches one template by slug via GET. Missing-slug text and the invalid-slug enum check diverge between languages (see report). Pagination is validated after the slug and before any request, with the shared text.

cases.name: gets a firewall template by slug
rejects an invalid slug (proto FirewallTemplateSlug enum)
cases.expect_error: slug must be one of: public, vpc

cases.name: rejects a page below one
cases.expect_error: page must be an integer greater than or equal to 1

cases.name: rejects a page_size below the minimum
cases.expect_error: page_size must be an integer from 25 through 500

cases.name: rejects a page_size above the maximum
cases.expect_error: page_size must be an integer from 25 through 500
